Straddles L11 meta-social: §1t24s0§ imports playerio and pushes §1t29s0§ instances into a roster (§1t553s0§) placed on a grid (§1t558s0§[x][y]), with the player inserted by charname at §1t24s0§.as:265 — this is the clan/castle roster. WEB-ONLY: the array and the letter ladder are both absent from shs3_android (grep returns nothing), another concrete instance of the S0-3 parity caveat. Its UI copy is still unheld — the 22xxx string ids it calls (getString(22080/22101/22102)) are OUTSIDE the Android Mobile_Lang_EN table, whose max id is 9010.
